title: Pollmaha´s Vanilla+ Pack
description: A modpack aiming to enchance minecraft in every single way!
body:
# Pollmaha´s Vanilla+ Pack
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88628296434b54055bf4ad3476f3edd7d9034ff8.png)
## A modpack aiming to enhance Minecraft in every way
### ![Featured](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36402e9ef4fd5680a73c0fec77e2cc2c86942362.jpeg)

The goal of this modpack is to ✨enhance✨ Minecraft Java Edition to run good on low-end devices like laptops, but also be visually more appealing. 

## Core Features
#
⚙️ **Performance & Optimization**

Optimized for stable framerates and low memory usage thanks to lightweight performance mods. Ideal for both low-end PCs and heavily modded clients.

🎨 **Visual & Audio Immersion**

Adds realistic soundscapes, dynamic lighting, camera effects, and environmental visuals. Experience Minecraft with atmosphere—without sacrificing performance.

🧰 **Quality of Life Enhancements**

Streamlined controls, UI tweaks, better tooltips, minimaps, building tools, and more make gameplay smoother without overwhelming new players.

🛠️ **Creative & Technical Suppor**t

From schematic tools to redstone enhancements, this pack provides tools useful for builders, engineers, and server admins alike.

## Q&A

_Question:_ **How much RAM is needed to run this modpack?**

This modpack should be perfectly working with 4 gigabytes.

_Question:_ **What inspired you to create this modpack?**

I was always a fan of modding and making my own pack, and I always had one problem: With some mods, it crashes. So I thought: What if I just publish my own modpack so people don´t have to get trough all this log-reading and removing mods they like? And that´s what I did.

_Question:_ **Will this modpack ever get ported to Forge?**

Not from me, but I won´t mind if you do it.

_Question:_ **Where can I download Recolorful Containers GUI Dark if I want it in newer versions?**

You can download it [here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/recolourful-containers-gui-hud-dark), it isn´t present in any newer versions because I´m not really comfortable with adding a CurseForge Pack to a Modrinth Modpack. But still: Thanks to [Vi_Tul on Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/vi_tul/projects) for this amazing texture pack!
